verdict.rationale: Vue says it builds on standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and its docs reference Single-File Component (SFC) syntax. Several hands-on reports describe .vue files holding HTML, JS and scoped CSS together in one component. Some developers note the template layer adds Vue-specific directives and DSL syntax beyond plain HTML/JS, which tempers the 'language I already know' part. Missing for 10: an in-depth first-party SFC structure guide in the pack, and evidence that templates need no new syntax to learn.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write markup and rendering logic together in a single component using markup, styles, and a language I already know

citations.quote: Builds on top of standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript with intuitive API and world-class documentation.
